### A brief history of Nvidia’s recent stock fluctuations
- Canonical URL: https://ainewsradar.xyz/news/07062ee1e8784a92
- Primary Source: The Verge AI (https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/1038063/nvidia-stock-market-price-earnings)
- Executive Summary: Nvidia's former CEO Jensen Huang resigned following misconduct allegations, causing the stock to drop nearly 40% from its October 6th peak, despite a record-breaking Q3 revenue of $115.8 billion and the rapid shipment of the Vera Rubin platform. Chairman Harvey Jones has confirmed that the board will not reinstate Huang and has initiated an executive search to stabilize leadership.
- Key Verified Facts:
* [Core Event] Former CEO Jensen Huang, Interim CEO Colette Kress, Chairman Harvey Jones: Jensen Huang resignation, refusal to reinstate, and focus on sustaining data center growth
* [Root Cause & Mechanism] Corporate governance crisis coupled with broader market skepticism regarding AI bubble valuation
* [Key Metrics] Q3 financials showing $115.8B revenue and strong Vera Rubin platform ramp-up.
* [Key Position & Outlook] Market volatility testing Nvidia's stability as the backbone of the AI economy amidst valuation corrections.
